title: windowsill pot.json
description: The sanitized snapshot the lab publishes and the /windowsill/ page consumes. Every field is optional so the page degrades to a procedural seed; this schema describes the shape when present. Shared by windowsill-lab (producer) and brokenbranchdevwebsite (consumer).

runs.description: distinct DATES on which the lab ran — days tended. Not the number of passes; see turns.count. Kept under its original name so existing consumers keep working.

turns.description: v5 — the pass counter and the DECLARED cadence. One turn = one scheduled pass, whichever machine took it. Optional: a feed without it degrades to the days-tended counter and the page's legacy freshness constants.

count.description: turns on the books (committed receipts). Omitted rather than guessed if receipts cannot be counted honestly.

today.description: turns filed under today's local date

expected_interval_h.description: hours between scheduled turns. Present ONLY while the cadence is declared AND effective — never inferred from observed history, so a silent machine can never lower its own bar.

last_by_machine.description: every DECLARED machine → its newest turn's timestamp, or null when it has never run. A declared-but-silent box is a fact, not a blank.

divergence.description: v5 — milestones whose verdicts partition perfectly along machine lines over the last 48h. Usually absent; present only when the machines are systematically disagreeing.

href.description: canonical report link emitted by the archive ledger; the page reads href, falling back to url

growth_form.description: Render-strategy hint derived from `track` (see BACKLOG.md §Growth forms): the *form* of the green thing — same pot, palette, and contract, only the form changes — so the kind of science is legible at a glance. Unknown/absent track falls back to the homogeneous default seedling.

runner_available.description: true only when `lab next` can dispatch this milestone instead of the M01 heartbeat

result.description: the technical result string, lifted from the MILESTONES.md '(done … — …)' parenthetical

short_label.description: story layer (src/lab/stories.py): 2-4 plain words naming the experiment

question_plain.description: story layer: the experiment's question in everyday, jargon-free language

why_it_matters.description: story layer: one sentence on why a curious non-expert should care

result_plain.description: story layer: a bounded plain-language finding; review/null language must preserve its non-promoted or failed status

report.description: One run on record — a node on the seedling stem (verified) or a folded grey leaf (null / unscored / unreadable). All fields optional so old consumers degrade. The archive ledger emits {date, milestone, verdict, headline, href, receipt_url}, plus {machine, at} where the run recorded its provenance, plus {group_count, group_first_date, group_machines} on a row standing for a collapsed streak of consecutive same-milestone same-verdict turns (v5 — the archive index keeps every run); the older compact record adds {experiment, peak_t, wall_s, url, code_sha, status}.

receipt_url.description: Stable compact evidence retaining checker inputs and provenance while explicitly hashing omitted heavy snapshots

group_count.description: this row stands for N consecutive turns of the same milestone with the same verdict; every underlying run remains in the archive index and receipts. Absent on a lone run — a streak of one is not a group. A verdict change and a missed calendar day both break the streak.

group_first_date.description: oldest date in the collapsed streak this row stands for; only present alongside group_count

group_machines.description: v5 — the distinct machines this collapsed group spans, sorted. The composition disclosure that makes cross-machine merging honest. Present only alongside group_count, and only when at least one member run recorded its provenance.

machine.description: v5 — which box took this turn (e.g. windows-cuda, linux-rocm), derived from the run's own receipt provenance. ABSENT, never null and never guessed, on runs that predate provenance stamping.

at.description: v5 — this run's own generated_at timestamp. Absent on runs that never recorded one; such a row renders date-only.
